scientific_integrity: Exact analytic argument for all stated admissible sufficiently small parameters, supplemented by exact-rational finite trajectory checks and numerical scaling checks. No claim of independent verification or universal publication priority.
scientific_limitations: The near-identity parameter family fixes b,c,lambda,kappa and takes delta down to zero. The limiting time law concerns uniform Lebesgue initial positions; only complete right-entry cells have exactly uniform microscopic undershoot. Time convergence is weak and in W1, not in total variation to a continuous law. No independent audit has been conducted; historical priority remains subject to unidentified equivalent theorems.
title: Critical capture-time crossover for two-interval affine circle maps
